name: finance-dashboard
description: Joseph's monthly finance dashboard — static site on Cloudflare Pages, gated by a server-side PIN (functions/_middleware.js).

scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler pages dev dist --port 4124
scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist && cp index.html dist/ && cp -R data dist/
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=finance-dashboard --commit-dirty=true
